findings.issue: In the fixed everyday farewell また明日, 明日 is read あした; あす is a formal/literary (news/announcement) reading and unnatural in this casual goodbye. Textbooks universally teach またあした.
findings.current: それでわまたあす
findings.suggested: それでわまたあした

findings.issue: Reading of 明日 in the farewell また明日 should be あした (colloquial), not あす (formal/literary register, wrong for this context).
findings.current: あす
findings.suggested: あした

findings.issue: '(therefore)' belongs to a different word — the conjunctive particle し ('and/so gives reasons'). Here し is the te-form stem of する in ようにしてほしい; the parenthetical teaches a wrong sense.
findings.current: to do (therefore) / to act
findings.suggested: to do (here: part of ようにする, 'make a point of')

findings.issue: '(por isso)' belongs to another sense (the conjunctive particle し 'e/por isso'). Here し is the raiz da forma て de する em ようにしてほしい; the parenthetical teaches a wrong sense.
findings.current: fazer (por isso) / agir
findings.suggested: fazer (aqui: parte de ようにする, 'fazer questão de')

findings.issue: 病院の受付で is a single noun phrase ('na recepção do hospital'); there is no は in the sentence. The lit invents a topic ('Quanto ao hospital') and a possessive resumption, misrepresenting genitive の as topic marking.
findings.current: Quanto ao hospital, na recepção dele, (eu) estou esperando.
findings.suggested: Na recepção do hospital, (eu) estou esperando.

findings.issue: Two inaccuracies: 'época' misrenders とき (time/moment when), and 'quanto a café' mirrors コーヒーを as if it were topic は — it is a を-marked direct object (corpus convention elsewhere marks を as '(objeto)').
findings.current: Em época sonolenta, quanto a café, bebo.
findings.suggested: No momento sonolento, café (objeto) bebo.

findings.issue: この店を is marked by を (object), not は; 'Quanto a...' is the corpus mirror for topic は (other items mark を as '(objeto)'). Structurally misleads about the particle. lit_en 'As for this shop' has the same problem.
findings.current: Quanto a esta loja, (você) a conhece?
findings.suggested: Esta loja (objeto), (você) conhece?

findings.issue: 茶色の靴を is a を-marked direct object, not a topic; 'Quanto a...' is the corpus mirror for は and misleads structurally (other items mark を as '(objeto)').
findings.current: Quanto a sapatos de cor marrom, (está) calçando(-os).
findings.suggested: Sapatos de cor marrom (objeto), (está) calçando.

findings.issue: Subject inconsistency: en translates the subjectless JP as 'She' but lit_en says 'he'. Also mirrors the を-object as a topic ('As for').
findings.current: As for the brown shoes, he's wearing them.
findings.suggested: The brown shoes (object), (she) is wearing.

findings.issue: Splits the single NP 病院の受付で into two separate locatives ('At the hospital... at the reception'); の is genitive linking one noun phrase.
findings.current: At the hospital, I am waiting at the reception.
findings.suggested: At the hospital's reception, (I) am waiting.

findings.issue: 'época' means era/period; とき in 眠いとき means the time/moment when — a gloss fitting another sense of the word, not this sentence.
findings.current: época / quando
findings.suggested: momento / quando

findings.issue: 本棚 is specifically a bookshelf/bookcase; 'shelf' alone (棚) is under-specific. The item's own token gloss says 'bookshelf'.
findings.current: I want to buy a new shelf.
findings.suggested: I want to buy a new bookshelf.

findings.issue: Same 本棚 imprecision as en: 'shelf' should be 'bookshelf'.
findings.current: A new shelf (object) I want to buy.
findings.suggested: A new bookshelf (object) I want to buy.

findings.issue: 〜つ is the general-purpose counter for things lacking a dedicated counter; 'counts shapeless things' is false as stated (apples have a definite shape) and misleads learners about when to use it.
findings.current: the generic counter 〜つ, which counts shapeless things (here, 五つ = いつつ)
findings.suggested: the generic counter 〜つ, used for things with no specific counter (here, 五つ = いつつ)

findings.issue: Same as expl_en: 'conta coisas sem forma específica' wrongly claims 〜つ counts shapeless things; it is the generic counter for things without a dedicated counter (a maçã tem forma definida).
findings.current: o contador genérico 〜つ, que conta coisas sem forma específica (aqui, 五つ = いつつ)
findings.suggested: o contador genérico 〜つ, usado para coisas sem contador específico (aqui, 五つ = いつつ)
